name: Sohei Azumi
source:
A natural-born leader who usually takes charge and pulls others along. However, due to certain circumstances, he has lost his passion and approaches life half-heartedly. With no interest in career advancement, he just goes through the motions at work. Called back by his boss while drinking at a local bar, he begrudgingly heads to the office—only to get caught up in the incident along the way.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4753680/Subway_0_Escape/]Steam[/url]]
